threepl.netlist.xilinx

Class XC4V

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.netlist.TDECode
      • threepl.netlist.GenFunctions
        • threepl.netlist.xilinx.XElements
          • threepl.netlist.xilinx.XFunctions
            • threepl.netlist.xilinx.XTDECode
              • threepl.netlist.xilinx.XC4V
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TDEConstants, NetConstants, Constant

    public class XC4V
extends XTDECode
implements NetConstants

    This class implements Xilinx library elements particular to Virtex 4 FPGAs. These are low level elements from which the output EDIF netlist is generated. All higher level functions call these, directly or indirectly.
